**handlers:** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`; **convergence function:** `PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

These RPC handlers can transitively POST to user-configured webhook URLs (stored via `CreateUserWebhook` / `UpdateUserWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go`):

| Handler | Path to webhook dispatch |
|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`) |
| `UpdateMemo` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_service.go:513`, `memo_update_helpers.go:67`) |
| `DeleteMemo` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_service.go:562`) |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_service_comments.go:119`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:43`) |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → … → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`) |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → … → `webhook.PostAsync` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`) |

All webhook paths set `payload.URL = hook.Url` from `GetUserWebhooks` and then call `webhook.PostAsync`:
